newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals steady in limited activity.
newsitem.headline: India metals steady in limited activity.

text.p: Base metals were steady on the local market amid limited activity on Wednesday, dealers said.
Industrial buying was at a low ebb and sentiment was subdued amid reports of weak trends in the world market.
"Price hike of 3,000 rupees per tonne announced by the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd. for the second half of current month failed to cheer up market sentiment," said Sharad Parikh, a leading dealer.
"However zinc may move up tomorrow on this news," he said.
Ready zinc was steady at 8,150 rupees per quintal as was lead at 4,100 rupees and aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal in thin activity.
Copper was steady at 13,650 rupees per quintal after losing 50 rupees on Tuesday. Tin was quiet at 29,000 rupees, as was nickel at 33,800 rupees per quintal.
Trading volume remained poor during the day due to poor attendance among the traders on account of a Hindu festival.
